player_prompt.intro:
U ena le Player {player_id} ka potlako ya IteratedTwoThirdsAverage e nang le makhuduthamaga a {num_rounds}.
Ka mokhuthamaga o mong le o mong, eka tseba nambari pakeng tsa {min_guess} le {max_guess}.
Kamora makhethe e mabeli, sepheo ke (2/3)x(palo ya makhethe a mabeli),
le player ya khethe e haufi le sepheo o thabile mokhuthamaga oo.
Araba ka khethe ya hao ka mokhoa wa '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Sebopeho se fosahetseng; ka kopo romella khopolo ea hau e le [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ho hakanya ho tlameha hore e be pakeng tsa {min_guess} le {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Mothami 0 o ile a hlokometse {guess0}; Mothami 1 o ile a hlokometse {guess1}. Kahoo, Theko ke: {target}.

outcome.p0_wins: Sebapali sa 0 se hlōtse lipotoloho tse ngata.
outcome.p1_wins: Sebapali sa pele se ile sa hlōla makhetlo a mangata.
outcome.draw: Papali e akaretsang ke ho behelana ha likhau.
